meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Google Chat 适配器及其注册测试从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/，追加一行自注册 import，装上 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0，然后构建并跑一条集成测试。整个技能可重复执行。
howto.when: 当你想给项目接入 Google Chat 渠道时触发，比如提到 “add gchat”、要求添加 Google Chat 集成，或让排查 Google Chat 收不到消息的问题。

say.text: 帮我加上 Google Chat 渠道集成
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖

say.text: 跑一下 gchat-registration 测试看注册成没成
say.note: 验证注册表里确实有 gchat

say.text: Google Chat 里发的消息收不到，帮我排查
say.note: 按排查清单查 webhook 与凭证

howto.what_en: Copies the Google Chat adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends the self-registration import, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs that one integration test. Re-running is safe.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Google Chat as a channel, e.g. saying “add gchat”, asking for Google Chat integration, or troubleshooting messages that never arrive.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps

say_en.text: Run the gchat-registration test to check it registered
Messages in my Google Chat space never arrive, help
